world.scenario: Deep undercover agent Alex has infiltrated a high-security data center but is trapped in the outer lobby. The path to the core server room involves decoding a safe, retrieving a decryption tool hidden behind a false wall, and finally bypassing a biometric lock on the main door.
world.objective: Retrieve the Master Decryption Key from Room 4 to unlock the final containment unit.

rooms.description: A sterile lobby with a reinforced steel door leading deeper into the facility. A heavy safe sits against the far wall, and a discarded datapad lies on the floor nearby.
A narrow corridor lined with server racks. A locked drawer sits on a maintenance cart, and a flickering fluorescent light hangs from the ceiling. A heavy steel door blocks the way forward.
A large open server room with rows of humming machines. A massive blast door seals the exit to the control room, and a small vent grate is welded shut near the floor.
rooms.goal: Bring the sekring_MAIN_ON power line online.

rooms.description: The final control room containing the Master Decryption Key in a secure container. A blast door leads back to the previous area, and two suspicious technicians are standing nearby.

objects.description: A crumpled datapad left by a previous agent.
The front door of the heavy safe.
A specialized breaker tool found inside the maintenance drawer.
The central hub controlling the room's power systems.
A key found behind the vent once accessed.
The secure lock holding the Master Decryption Key.
A crumpled piece of paper on the floor.
A small desk drawer that appears empty.
A handwritten note taped to a wall.
An old safe in the corner of the room.

rules: Accessing room 2 requires unlocking the steel safe in room 1.
Accessing room 3 requires having the circuit breaker tool from room 2.
Accessing room 4 requires disabling the power grid via the server console in room 3.
Winning requires unlocking the final container in room 4.
solution_path: 1. Take discarded_datapad_1 from room_1 to reveal the object.
2. Enter code the hidden code on steel_safe_door in room_1 to unlock it and access the object.
3. Pass through the unlocked door to reach room_2.
4. Take circuit_breaker_tool from the object (code the hidden code) in room_2.
5. Use circuit_breaker_tool on the object in room_3 to reveal security_override_key.
6. Take security_override_key and use it on server_main_console to disable the object.
7. Power is off, allowing access to the object in room_3 (gate opens).
8. Enter room_4 and solve final_container_lock with code the hidden code.
